text: Test your logic. Seven riddles, fifteen seconds each. Can you get them all?
A bat and a ball cost one dollar and ten cents in total.
The bat costs one dollar more than the ball.
How much does the ball cost?
Fifteen seconds. Pause the video if you need more time. Comment your answer. Go!
Time's up! Did you say ten cents?
Then the bat would cost one dollar and ten cents, and together, one dollar and twenty cents.
The answer is five cents: five cents plus one dollar and five cents makes exactly one dollar and ten cents.
Now riddle seven, the one that fooled even mathematicians.
Three doors: a car behind one, goats behind the other two.
You pick door one. The host, who knows where the car is, opens door three: a goat.
Do you stay, or switch to door two?
The answer, and five more riddles, are in the full video on our YouTube channel, Factora.
